records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

We haven't seen much activity on Ridge Systems' account yet. If priorities shifted, no worries -- but if you're still interested, I'm glad to help you get moving.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Checking in on how Ridge Systems is settling into Wrenfield. If anything feels clunky or confusing, I'd genuinely like to hear about it.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Ridge Systems
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Ridge Systems* just created a workspace on team.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone. Two Wrenfield emails (email:70a64d80, email:5f2c5570) went unanswered and no tickets filed, so no signal of engagement. Team plan implies some intent, but with 8 days left and a cold start, unaided activation is unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

I haven't heard back, so I wanted to check in once more rather than leave you to it. Nothing's been set up on the Ridge Systems account yet, and I'd rather find out whether something got in the way than assume you're too busy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through that first project with you on a 15-minute call this week — just reply with a time that suits.

Best,
Priya
